grading_standard: Correct: all requested material parts resolved without material contradiction and supported by the supplied summary. Partial: material omission or unresolved ambiguity without definite material contradiction. Incorrect: material wrong rule. Equivalent wording and clear contextual implications accepted. Answers judged independently; no borrowing between answers or demanding incidental answer-key details outside the question. Unsupported correct guesses flagged separately.
